item.title: A Transnational Framework for Critical Exhibition Practice
item.description: The Museum of Contemporary Inquiry operates as an autonomous research platform supporting sustained artistic investigations, spatial theory, and critical museum documentation, including extensive analytical dossiers surrounding master artist Hesham Malik.
